summary: Re-validated EDUSENSE after monolith→modular refactor (server.py 91 lines + core/ + routes/*) and three new features. 59/59 backend pytest cases pass (all 40 pre-existing + 19 new): children CRUD with parent-only writes & principal-read-all & teacher-403, child_id linkage on POST /api/astrology/niche and POST /api/sentiment/records with filtered GETs, GET /api/sentiment/trend (default 30 buckets, ?days=7 → 7 buckets, teacher allowed, parent 403, days=0/181 → 422), and analytics_overview now exposes total_children. Frontend Playwright verified: parent registration → ParentDashboard renders ChildrenManager card → Add child dialog (name/dob/age/grade/notes) → child saved to children-list with grade/age/DOB badges → edit/delete IDs resolved; principal login (via Principal tab) → PrincipalDashboard SentimentTrendChart card visible with stacked area chart + Avg Likert line chart + range selector showing all 5 options (7/14/30/60/90 days), 9 SVGs rendered. Carry-over Users-by-role pie chart from iteration_1/2 is now rendering correctly (resolved).

issues: DOB field uses browser-native date picker (input type='date', shows mm/dd/yyyy) instead of shadcn Calendar component as preferred by the design system. Functional but inconsistent with rest of UI.

Backend /api/analytics/overview now returns total_children but the dashboard tile row (Total Users / Students / Teachers / Astro Consults) does not surface a 'Children' counter. Not blocking but the backend value is unused on UI.
Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' — add a DialogDescription for a11y.

action_items: (Minor a11y) Add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to ChildrenManager Add-child Dialog to silence Radix warning.
(Optional UX) Replace native date input in child-dob-input with the shadcn Calendar/DatePicker for design consistency.
(Optional UX) Add a 'Children' KPI tile on PrincipalDashboard sourced from analytics.total_children (already returned by backend).
critical_code_review_comments: Refactor is clean: server.py is 91 lines, routes/* are focused and use absolute imports (from core.X) — no regressions detected. lifespan migration done.

routes/sentiment.py /trend endpoint loads up to 180 days of records into Python and aggregates in-process; for scale, prefer a $group MongoDB pipeline keyed by date bucket. Acceptable for current dataset.

routes/children.py update_child filters out None values via 'if v is not None' — this prevents clearing optional fields (e.g., notes) by sending null. If clearing is desired, distinguish unset vs explicit-null.
Children create endpoint does not validate date_of_birth format (YYYY-MM-DD) server-side; relies on client. Add a regex/Field validator.
core/auth + core/llm not viewed deeply but routes import them consistently; tests exercise the wiring end-to-end (register/login/me, LLM endpoints all green).
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True still misconfigured per CORS spec (carry-over from iteration_2). Auth uses Bearer header so no current impact.
Recommend wrapping run_sentiment with asyncio.wait_for(timeout=45) — current implementation could stall workers on slow LLM responses (carry-over).
